guidance:
Copal engineering policy for src/invoice/total.ts — follow these rules when writing code:

- [ENFORCED] hardcoded-credentials: Never hard-code credentials; read them from configuration/secret manager. — Credentials in source end up in git history, prompts and logs. Load them from the secret manager.
- [ENFORCED] sql-injection: SQL built by string concatenation/interpolation — Use parameterised queries so user input can never change the statement.
- [audit] path-traversal: File path built from request input — Resolve against an allow-listed base directory and reject '..' segments.
- [audit] no-console: console.log left in production code — Use the structured logger so output is levelled and redacted.
- [audit] no-explicit-any: Explicit `any` disables type checking — Prefer a precise type or `unknown` with narrowing.
- [ENFORCED] ledger-rounding: Inline rounding bypasses LedgerPort — Rounding in one place keeps invoices and the ledger reconciled. (preferred: LedgerPort.round($1, Currency.EUR))
- [audit] invoice-contract-test: Add/update a test matching src/invoice/{name}.test.ts — Invoice maths is contract-tested against the ledger fixtures.
